label: Revision-original AQA-aligned practice question (not an AQA question)

question.context: Original Revision numerical practice: a café has fixed monthly costs of £5,000, price of £16 per sandwich and variable costs which have just risen from £6 to £8 per sandwich.
question.stem: After the variable-cost increase, calculate the new break-even output in whole sandwiches.

points.descriptor: Calculates the revised break-even output of 625 sandwiches, using £16 − £8 = £8 contribution per unit and £5,000 ÷ £8.

mark_scheme.model_answer: Contribution per unit = £16 − £8 = £8. Break-even output = £5,000 ÷ £8 = 625 sandwiches per month.
